page.layout: One printed page, the left one of the spread. Centred title block at top: "INDEX" / "DIALOGISMORUM" / "LIBRI PRIMI.". Below it, a list of entries in one column, with folio numbers at the right, opened by a woodcut initial. Centred "LIBRI SECUNDI." heading, then a second list of entries with folio numbers at the right. "LIBRI" alone at the lower right, below the last line. Right edge: a strip of the neighbouring page, not transcribed.

page.notes: Woodcut initial at the start of the first entry, read as P with the rest of the word "Præfaciuncula" (printed "Præfacivncvla"); the first letter is uncertain. "transfuectione" is printed this way; the expected form is "transuectione", so it is marked [?]. Folio numbers are placed on the printed line where they stand. A small mark near the lower centre is not a page number and is left out. No running head printed.
